text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali looks at the air transport file. Decides to lift tax at the two international airports of Tabarka and Tozeur.
- President looks at the road safety file.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui opens the provincial governors' conference.
- Karoui to leave for Jordan on Sunday for talks on bilateral cooperation.
- By-elections on Sunday in ben Arous, Medenine.
- EU donates Tunisia 100 million ecus for restructuring.
- Parliament debates the Justice Ministry 1997 budget.
- Tunisia, Libya start talks on cooperation in the education sector.
